name: Women Wellness
description: Millet snacks made with ingredients traditionally valued for women's daily nourishment. Wholesome, satisfying, and easy to carry through a busy day.

name: Peanut Chikki
description: The classic peanut chikki, made the way it has always been made. Roasted peanuts, jaggery, and nothing unnecessary.

name: Nuts n Seeds
description: Dense with almonds, cashews and seeds. A small piece that carries you between meals without reaching for anything fried.

name: Millets n Nuts
description: Ancient grains meeting everyday nuts. Ragi, oats and millets give the base its substance; the nuts give it the bite.

name: Kids Wellness
description: Snacks children reach for and parents feel comfortable giving. Sweetened with jaggery and honey rather than refined sugar.

name: Fruit Variant
description: Real fruit flavour folded into a millet base. Bright, fragrant, and a change from the usual.
